name: campus-event-planner
description: Multi-agent club event planning team for student societies: proposals, budget, risk plan and promo kit for internal and public club activities.

displayDescription.en: A multi-agent team for student club events: feed in activity info and it parallel-produces proposal, budget, risk plan and promo copy.
displayDescription.zh: 面向学生社团的活动策划天团：输入活动信息，并行产出策划方案、预算、风险预案与宣传文案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我们策划一场社团迎新破冰，新成员 60 人，11月13日晚在活动室，预算 800 以内，要完整策划书、预算和应急预案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Plan a club ice-breaker for 60 new members on Nov 13 evening at our club room, budget under 800 CNY, with full proposal, budget and risk plan.

quickPrompts.en: Plan a club ice-breaker for 60 new members on Nov 13 evening at our club room, budget under 800 CNY, with full proposal, budget and risk plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我们策划一场社团迎新破冰，新成员 60 人，11月13日晚在活动室，预算 800 以内，要完整策划书、预算和应急预案。

quickPrompts.en: We're running a two-day club recruitment booth. Give me a plan with materials list, staffing, budget and rain contingency.
quickPrompts.zh: 我们要办两天招新摆摊，帮我出个方案，要有物料清单、人员分工、预算和下雨的备用方案。

quickPrompts.en: Write recruiting copy and poster slogans for our tech club, targeting freshmen, casual and lively tone.
quickPrompts.zh: 给我们社团写一版招新文案和海报文案，面向大一新生，语气活泼别太官方。
